comments.body: 2026-11-19: no fix landed. The wheel and click surface_input tests start with stty raw, so they are very likely the SIGTTOU race fixed today (e6ca7d1d, 344c84df on a_2nSLy8B6Y). A loop of surface_input::, unreachable:: and detection::a_dialog_answered, 3 x 40 runs at load 6-10, failed 0 times. The fake-agent tests (detection, unreachable) start the agent as a forked job and may be a_32l8l7oxc's race; read a future failure's screen for Stopped(SIGTT...) before calling it slowness. The third surface_input test the card counts is unnamed and unexplained. Back to backlog-hi until it fails again with a message.

Same family as the other under-load cards: find which deadline each waits on and whether it can wait on an event instead.
title: Detection and seam surface_input tests time out under heavy load
